subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear [Recipient], We are delighted to invite you to our annual charity gala to be held on Saturday, December 12th at the Grand Ballroom. Join us for an evening of live music, gourmet dining, and a silent auction to benefit local charities. RSVP by November 30th to secure your spot. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Your Name]
